'''''Claw Squadron''''' was a large [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]]. The squadron along with [[Jerrid Squadron]] were part of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Skirmish at Klaatu|raid]] against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|Convoy]] that the Empire "leaked" out to the Airams to capture more Airam members to find their base. Claw Squadron underestimated the Imperials [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] and were likely wiped out and their ships that were supposed to capture the Convoy were instead captured by the Empire's own [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper tranpsorts]].
